input.summary: Implemented an in-memory Task Management API per the architecture spec. Files added under src/: event-bus, services (user, project, task, comment, notification), router, main, and demo. EventBus is in-memory pub/sub. Services maintain their own Maps and expose methods; Task and Comment services publish events to EventBus; NotificationService subscribes to events and creates notifications. Router is an HTTP JSON API using Node's http module with the specified routes and enriches/publishes events when needed. Demo script exercises the end-to-end flow. Project compiles with TypeScript (npx tsc --noEmit successful).
